index.title: Preferences
index.subtitle: Account and billing settings
index.planDescription: View your plan, usage, and upgrade options.
index.languageDescription: The language of this back office on this device. Menu items and names stay as you typed them.
index.themeDescription: Coming soon — currently follows your system color scheme.

plan.title: Plan & billing
plan.subtitle: Two totals, kept apart: what you pay once, and what you pay every month.

notYours.inactiveTitle: Your restaurant’s package is inactive — ask the owner
notYours.lockedTitle: Only the restaurant owner can change the package
notYours.inactiveBody: The storefront and back office for {branch} are paused until the restaurant owner chooses a package. Nothing has been deleted, and your work comes back as soon as it is active again.
notYours.lockedBody: {branch}’s package is managed by the restaurant owner. Ask them if you need a feature that is not switched on.

replaceDialog.title: Replace your pending request?
replaceDialog.body: Your earlier request ({summary}) is withdrawn and this one goes to the Favornoms team instead.
replaceDialog.codeReleased: Code {code} was on that request. Apply it again here to keep it; otherwise it is given back.

errors.sendFailed: Could not send your request. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then send the request.
errors.forbidden: Only the restaurant owner can change the package.
errors.planUnavailable: That package is not available any more. Reload the page and choose again.

now.title: What you have now
now.deliveryTrial: Every branch, free until the trial ends

branches.title: Your branches
branches.subtitle: Every branch is {price} a month. Switch on Delivery for the branches that deliver.
branches.subtitleNoPrice: Switch on Delivery for the branches that deliver.
branches.empty: This restaurant has no active branch yet.
branches.alreadyUnlocked: Already unlocked — nothing more to pay once for this branch.
branches.offWarning: {branch} will stop offering delivery on its storefront.
branches.trialNote: Every branch delivers free until your trial ends. What you leave switched on here is what you pay for afterwards.

seats.title: Add a branch
seats.body: +{once} once, +{monthly}/mo for each branch after the first.
seats.usage: Using {used} of {seats, plural, one {# branch you pay for} other {# branches you pay for}}.
seats.floor: You run {count, plural, one {# active branch} other {# active branches}}, so you cannot go below {min}. To pay for one less, hide a branch you no longer use: open its Branch settings and set Status to Hidden. A hidden branch is not billed.
seats.newSeats: {count, plural, one {# branch you have not created yet} other {# branches you have not created yet}}. Create new branches from the Branches page once this is approved.
seats.newSeatsReady: {count, plural, one {# branch you have paid for is not created yet} other {# branches you have paid for are not created yet}}. Create it from the Branches page whenever you are ready.

pay.title: What you pay
pay.onceNothing: Nothing. Everything in this package is already paid for.
pay.onceAwaiting: Nothing has been charged yet. You pay this when the Favornoms team activates your request.
pay.unusedSeats: {count, plural, one {# branch not created yet} other {# branches not created yet}}
pay.trialNote: Nothing is charged while your free trial runs. This is your first bill when you confirm.
pay.footnote: Your request goes to the Favornoms team for activation. You are invoiced monthly.

discount.title: Discount code
discount.repriced: You changed the package. Press Apply to check the code against the new total.
discount.notApplied: This code has not been applied. Press Apply to use it, or clear the box to send the request without it.
discount.onlyOnce: A code comes off what you pay once, never off the monthly bill.

trial.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left in your free trial} other {# days left in your free trial}}
trial.body: Everything is unlocked, delivery included at every branch. Choose what you keep below — no card needed until the trial ends.

suspended.title: Your account is not active
suspended.body: Your storefront is offline and new orders are blocked. Nothing has been deleted — choose a package below and everything comes straight back.

noTrial.title: This restaurant starts without a free trial
noTrial.body: Your account already used its 14-day free trial on another restaurant. This one stays offline until it has a package: choose one below and send the request, and the Favornoms team activates it.

renew.title: Renew your package
renew.body: Your current package is selected below. Press Request renewal to send it to the Favornoms team — nothing renews until they approve it. You can also change the package before sending.

pricesUnavailable.title: Prices could not be loaded
pricesUnavailable.body: We could not read the price list just now, so this page cannot quote a package. Nothing on your account has changed. Reload the page in a moment.
pricesUnavailable.pay: No figures until the price list loads, and nothing can be sent in the meantime.

decision.noReason: No reason was given. You can choose a package below and send a new request.

pending.title: Request waiting for the Favornoms team
pending.titleSent: Request waiting for the Favornoms team · sent {date}
pending.body: Nothing changes until it is approved. To ask for something else, change the package below and press Replace pending request.
